description: This file defines a configuration class for interacting with Stability AI's image editing API, handling parameter translation, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing specific to Stability AI's image edit endpoints.

classes.name: StabilityImageEditConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Stability AI's image editing API, including methods for parameter mapping, URL generation, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by Stability AI for image editing.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, image_edit_optional_params: ImageEditOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Converts OpenAI-style request parameters into Stability AI-specific parameters, supporting mapping and parameter validation.

methods.name: str _get_model_endpoint(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines the API endpoint URL segment for a given model name.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for a given model, base URL, and parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Checks essential environment variables and sets authorization headers for Stability AI requests.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,RequestFiles] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms a high-level image edit request into the format expected by Stability AI, including multipart form data.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the raw response from Stability AI and converts it into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse format.

methods.name: bool use_multipart_form_data(self)
methods.description: Indicates that Stability AI requires multipart/form-data encoding for image requests.
